scope: 20 executed native C policy assertions + static Objective-C wiring checks; no iOS runtime testing
static_checks: Editor exit holds controls until the session has restarted
Editor exit releases worker ownership on main queue
Control updates derive capture ownership including the editor
Pressure/memory recovery refreshes controls before scheduler early exits
First shutter does not get swallowed by PhotoKit authorization
Worker requests add-only permission and resumes its persisted job
Every capture gate uses the same mode-aware admission
Queue calls the tested production policy
Recording journal is not runnable until the final callback
Completed recording is made runnable only after a successful journal write
Final photo callback waits behind serial disk writes before releasing shutter
Malformed recovery list entries are checked before keyed use
Malformed individual recovery records are rejected
